rationale: The short thesis is intact — price remains below VWAP (33.75) and the invalidation at 33.80 has not triggered, and the bounce off 33.41 is running on roughly half the volume of the preceding flush (43–53k vs 109–128k), i.e., a corrective drift into the 9-EMA rather than impulsive buying. Risk to the invalidation (~$50 on 238 shares) versus reward to the 33.15 target (~$105) is roughly 2:1, so exiting at -0.15% eight minutes in would pay the spread to avoid a scenario the plan already prices. A flip to long would require trading against the session's lower-high/lower-low structure and the risk-off tape on just two modest green candles — well short of the evidence bar for reversing.
